thread:
sara: Quick heads-up — final cutoff for v2.7 is in ~2 hours. Code freeze is on at cutoff. No merges without a formal late-merge exception. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tom: FYI I have a small hotfix for a 500 in model-routing (causes fallback storms). PR is tiny but it's needed for a major customer. Requesting exception.

sara: @tom please add the PR link, short risk / rollback plan, and smoke test steps. We'll need QA + oncall ok. Tag PR with `release/late-merge` label.

tom: PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pull/4921
Test plan: repro on staging with a synthetic spike, verify routing falls back cleanly, metrics: 5xx rate back to baseline within 2m, no increased latency.

maya (qa): I can run manual smoke in 30m. Do we have a clear rollback?

tom: Rollback is simple — revert the cherry-pick and deploy previous release; config flag `enable-new-routing=false` also available as immediate mitigation.

linh (tech-lead): Who's owning the deploy? Need someone to watch metrics and be available to rollback for 30m post-deploy.

tom: I can own it — I'll be on call and reachable.

qa-bot: e2e/canary pipeline: passed (unit+integration). Staging e2e pending (queued).

maya (qa): I'll prioritize the staging smoke. If I see anything flaky I'll flag immediately.

sara: OK — prereqs for exception: 1) PR with `release/late-merge` label and changelog line 2) clear test plan + QA sign-off 3) owner on call during deploy 4) deploy window inside last 90 minutes before cutoff with no other late merges.

tom: Done: added label + changelog entry, linked test checklist in PR description.

maya (qa): Staging smoke completed: critical paths ok, 5xxs stable. +1 from QA, will be monitoring for 30m.

linh (tech-lead): +1 from me for rollout. Agree owner (tom) on call. Suggest canary at 10% for 10m then 50% for 10m.

sara: Exception approved. Conditions: canary rollout as described, observability alerts unmuted for on-call, rollback command ready. I'll add a release note about the exception. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: v2.7-hotfix-4921 -> production in 15m. Canary 10% 10m -> 50% 10m -> full.

tom: Deploy commands (for reference):
```
# create cherry-pick branch
git fetch origin main && git checkout -b release/late-merge-4921
git cherry-pick -x ab12c3d
git push origin release/late-merge-4921
```

maya (qa): I'll keep monitoring dashboards and alerting for 30m post-full rollout.

sara: Thanks everyone. Reminder: after cutoff no new exceptions unless it's a SEV1. If you need to request one, follow the same flow and ping me directly. :lock:
